pico_gaps.gap: HFpEF-specific subgroup data are sparse across the included set.
Head-to-head comparisons between transition intervention types are absent.
Medication adherence is rarely reported as a distinct outcome.

outcome_gaps: 30-day ED visit rate reported separately from readmission
Medication adherence as a distinct measured outcome
population_gaps: HFpEF patients analyzed separately from HFrEF
recency_gaps: Evidence spans 2009-2024; this small demo set skews toward well-cited landmark studies rather than the most recent literature.
design_gaps: Head-to-head RCTs comparing different transition intervention types

suggested_queries.target_gap: Head-to-head comparative effectiveness of transition models
suggested_queries.query: (care transitions[tiab] OR transitional care[tiab]) AND heart failure[Mesh] AND (comparative effectiveness[tiab] OR network meta-analysis[tiab]) AND readmission[tiab]
suggested_queries.rationale: Identify direct comparison RCTs and network meta-analyses ranking transition modalities

recommendation_rationale: This is an illustrative 6-article demo set, not a real completed review; it is included to show the /lit-review output format and is not intended to represent a real gap analysis.
